T0560.title: Ad Attribution
T0560.definition: The process of assigning credit for installs, purchases, registrations, or conversions to marketing touchpoints.
T0560.description: Ad attribution decides which marketing touchpoint receives credit, so it is targeted by click hijacking, cookie stuffing, install farms, and fake conversions. Attribution-quality reviews should examine touchpoint timelines, device consistency, abnormal channel conversion rates, duplicate attribution, and incentive-settlement rules.
T0560.usageExample: Assess Ad Attribution related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
